ES:
{{TAG:0003:0010:}}¡Ah, por cierto!{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} Esto...{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} ¡Gracias por
salvarme la vida el otro día!{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0025:}}A lo mejor crees que soy una
exagerada, pero si no fuese por
ti, ¡seguiría a tope con el catarro!
{{TAG:0003:0015:}}Y para agradecértelo,{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}{{TAG:0003:0025:}} tengo una
cosilla para ti. Te la mandaré por
correo, ¡que no se te olvide!
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0010:}}Au fait,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} merci pour,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} t'sais,{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} l'autre
jour...{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} quand tu m'as sauvé la vie !{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Chuis plus malade grâce à toi !
{{TAG:0003:0015:}}Du coup, j'ai pas résisté à l'envie
d'te faire un cadeau,{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} {{TAG:0005:0007:}}.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0025:}}J'te l'ai envoyé avec une lettre, ça
devrait pas tarder à atterrir dans ta
boîte aux lettres !
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0010:}}Oh, sì!{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} Grazie per,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} insomma,{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}
avermi salvato la vita l'altro giorno!{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Ora non ho più il raffreddore!
{{TAG:0003:0015:}}La tua {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}medicina{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}} è stata davvero
provvidenziale,{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}{{TAG:0003:0025:}} perciò ti meriti
un regalo.
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Te l'ho già spedito in realtà, insieme
a una lettera, quindi poi controlla,
{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0010:}}Aa evet!{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} Geçen gün,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} şey,{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} hayatımı
kurtardığın için sağ ol!{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}} {{TAG:0003:0025:}}Senin sayende
soğuk algınlığım geçti! {{TAG:0003:0015:}}Beni resmen
ayağa kaldırdın,{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}{{TAG:0003:0025:}} ben de sana bir hediye
aldım.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Mektupla yolladım, sonra posta
kutuna bak! {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:000E:0003:}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!

FR:
{{TAG:0003:0010:}}T'sais qu'j'vais vachement mieux,
maintenant ?{{TAG:0007:0000:1E000000}} {{TAG:0003:0025:}}Et c'est grâce à ton
{{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}remède{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}} !
{{TAG:0003:0000:}}Vu qu't'es un peu comme mon ange
gardien, j'tenais à t'offrir un
cadeau, {{TAG:0005:0007:}}{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0015:}}J'l'ai envoyé chez toi par la poste.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}C'est pas grand-chose, mais
j'espère qu'ça t'plaira !

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0010:}}Hey! {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}You don't need to worry about
me anymore.{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}} {{TAG:0003:0025:}}I'm all better now!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:001B:}}Yeah, {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}we totally gave that cold the
beat down!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} It was like, {{TAG:0003:002C:}}"Pow!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Take
that {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}medicine{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}, you dumb cold!"
{{TAG:0003:0015:}}That secret potion or whatever
worked great!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0025:}}As a thanks, I'm sending you a gift
in the mail.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} Look out for it, OK?
{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:000E:0003:}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0010:}}¡Atiende! {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}Ya no hace falta que
te preocupes por mí.{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}} {{TAG:0003:0025:}}¡Me he
recuperado!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:001B:}}Sí, sí, {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}¡he sobrevivido al resfriado!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}
Fue muy emocionante, {{TAG:0003:002C:}}como un
combate{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} o algo parecido, ¡ji, ji!
{{TAG:0003:0015:}}No sé si era una poción secreta o
una {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}medicina {{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}normal y corriente,
¡pero no veas qué bien me sentó!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Para darte las gracias, te voy a
enviar un detallito por correo.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}
Estate atent{{TAG:000E:0006:02006F0002006100}}, ¿eh?
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0010:}}Au fait !{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} Plus besoin d'te faire de
souci pour moi.{{TAG:0007:0000:1E000000}} {{TAG:0003:0025:}}Chuis totalement
guérie, et c'est grâce à toi !
{{TAG:0003:001B:}}Ce fichu virus,{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} on lui a fait sa fête
façon : {{TAG:0003:002C:}}« Paf !{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Mange ce {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}remède{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}
dans ta face, sale rhume ! »
{{TAG:0003:0015:}}Faut bien avouer qu'il était coriace,
le bougre.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Pour t'remercier, j't'ai envoyé un
p'tit truc chez toi.{{TAG:0007:0000:0F000000}} Penses-y, OK ?{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}
{{TAG:000E:0003:}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}} !
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0010:}}Ehi! {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}Non ti devi più preoccupare
per me.{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}} {{TAG:0003:0025:}}Sto molto meglio ora!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:001B:}}Sì, {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}alla fine abbiamo messo
il raffreddore al tappeto!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Gli ho

{{TAG:0003:0015:}}Quella pozione segreta

DE:
{{TAG:0003:0010:}}Hey!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Um mich brauchst du dir
keine Sorgen mehr zu machen.{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}{{TAG:0003:0025:}}
Mir geht's schon wieder blendend!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0020:}}Yeah, {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}wir haben's dieser Erkältung
so richtig gegeben!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} {{TAG:0003:002C:}}Zack,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} etwas von

{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Ich hab 'n Geschenk für dich
